conditions: past values (lags 1..24 of the same feature)
forbidden_conditions: any row after the fold fit range
generator.innovation_law: empirical standardized fit residuals (bootstrap); scale model log(e^2) ~ calendar + delta_time
generator.fit_scope: fold fit anchors only (inner TRAIN folds inner_2019..inner_2023)
generator.diagnostic_scope: fold inner validation range (inside TRAIN, outside the generator fit)

regime_coverage.definition: share of real rolling-std (168h) deciles whose synthetic occupancy is within [0.5, 2.0] x the real occupancy

prefix_invariance.definition: perturbing real values at or after the synthesis start changes no synthetic value (FS01-style); innovations at t depend on rows <= t only

second_moment_gap_per_feature.definition: max_k | corr(X_j,X_k) - corr(X~_j,X_k) | and | corr(X~_j,X~_k) - corr(X_j,X_k) | over k != j on fit rows

swap_classifier_auc_batch.definition: held-out AUC of a logistic classifier told to distinguish [X, X~] rows from rows with a random subset of columns swapped; 0.5 = exchangeable

conditional_independence_abs_z.definition: partial correlation z of Y with X~_j given X_j on fit rows (leak guard: Y never enters the generator)

decision.generator_state: CALIBRATED if every generator gate passes on the fold, else NOT_CALIBRATED with the failing gate names
decision.knockoff_state: RUN only for features whose generator_state is CALIBRATED on the fold AND whose exchangeability gates pass; else NOT_CALIBRATED
decision.feature_summary_rule: CALIBRATED when CALIBRATED on >= 3 of 5 folds (lane B fold_majority = 3); otherwise NOT_CALIBRATED
decision.no_series: features of the 366 denominator without a series in any PS2 batch: calibration_state NOT_EVALUATED (reason NO_SERIES_IN_PS2_BATCH), knockoff_state NOT_CALIBRATED
decision.calendar_conditioning: the 10 cal.* candidates are generator conditions, not series: NOT_APPLICABLE

knockoffs.method: second-order Gaussian group knockoffs (Candes et al. 2018; Dai and Barber 2016 group equicorrelated S) on the generator's standardized innovations, Gaussian-copula mapped back to each feature's empirical innovation law; unobserved rows carry innovation 0 in both X and X~ (mask-symmetric)
knockoffs.groups: lane B per-fold dependence clusters from ps2_manifest.json fold_clusters[fold].dependence; singletons otherwise
knockoffs.statistic: group lasso-coefficient-difference W_g = sum_{j in g}|beta_j| - sum_{j in g}|beta~_j|, Lasso alpha by contiguous 5-fold LassoCV on fit rows; Y_b encoded TP=+1, SL=-1, timeout=0, no support excluded
knockoffs.targets: Y_s h1..h6, Y_l h24..h144, Y_b s6 and l144 (14 cells) x 5 folds
knockoffs.licence_check: knockpy MIT (admissible) not used: not installed in the worker env; in-repo implementation

use_of_output: evidence column only; never substitutes external utility, causal evidence or paired refit; generator reusable for stress tests/negatives even when NOT_CALIBRATED
